correctness.rationale: The slopes of the common convex absolute-deviation objective jump at distinct opinion values by twice their total weight. A nontrivial minimizer interval has no opinions inside and separates two groups of weight 1/2; for a singleton the strict weight on either side is less than 1/2. This includes ties. Endpoint agents do not move, and 0<γ_i<1 keeps all other agents strictly on their original side at every finite iterate. Those facts preserve both the interval and each projection target, giving the exact scalar recursion and the sup-norm error bound ||x(k)−p||∞≤(1−min_i γ_i)^k||x(0)−p||∞. For iid atomless starts the rank permutation is uniform and independent of the order statistics. A positive limit gap occurs for exactly one balanced rank cut, if any; the events for distinct subsets are disjoint by strict positivity. Each fixed subset of size s is exactly the lowest s ranks with probability 1/binomial(n,s). For iid uniform values the spacing transformation of the ordered sample has constant density on the simplex, so an interior spacing survives t with probability (1−t)^n. The index selected by a balanced prefix depends only on the independent permutation, giving the stated mixture (the conditional Beta law is read when p_pol>0). Equal weights give the claimed parity. For binary integer weights the positivity decision is precisely PARTITION, with an NP certificate and a pseudopolynomial subset-sum algorithm. The averaging comparison also has a direct check: in a nonconstant state all responses are in its old range, and any averaging agent is strictly inside after one step. Both old extremes cannot survive a second step, since their preservation would require at least half the weight at each extreme at the intervening time, contrary to that interior agent. Continuity and compactness on the initial range imply the nonincreasing diameter tends to zero; nested extrema then give convergence to a common value. This proves the credited structural consequence independently of exact all-median orbits. The frozen script was inspected but not executed; its finite diagnostics do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: Common positive influence rows give a natural all-to-all specialization. The result answers where each opinion converges and gives the full nonconsensus magnitude distribution rather than only whether distinct cohesive groups can exist. It exposes the exact role of weight balance: perturbations that eliminate exact half-weight coalitions make the polarization probability zero, whereas equal weights at even n force polarization for atomless iid starts. This is a model result, not empirical validation of polarization in social data.
